page.title: Data collection status
page.subtitle: Check whether SDK events are reaching Lynx and being stored in the database.
page.window: Calculated from real storage data collected over the last {hours} hours.

HEALTHY.label: Collecting
HEALTHY.title: Events are being stored normally
HEALTHY.description: Recent events were found and storage delay is within the normal range.

DELAYED.label: Delayed
DELAYED.title: Event storage is slower than expected
DELAYED.description: The p95 delay between the SDK event time and database storage is above five seconds.

INACTIVE.label: No recent data
INACTIVE.title: No events were stored in the last 15 minutes
INACTIVE.description: If traffic is expected, check the SDK connection, API key, and server logs.

NO_DATA.label: No data
NO_DATA.title: No events have been stored yet
NO_DATA.description: Collection status and storage delay will appear after the SDK sends its first event.

lastStoredAt.label: Last stored
lastStoredAt.description: Most recent event stored in the database

storedEvents.label: Stored events
storedEvents.description: Events stored during the last {hours} hours

storageDelay.label: Storage delay p95
storageDelay.description: From the SDK event time to database storage

volume.title: Stored events by hour
volume.description: Events stored in the database during the last 24 hours.
volume.empty: No events were stored during the last 24 hours.

empty.title: No workspace is available
empty.description: Create a workspace and connect the SDK to inspect collection status.

error.title: Could not load collection status
error.description: Check the ingestion status API response, then try again.
